Name: Dynamic Checklist
Author: gunnigolf
Description:
[size=5]Mod Description[/size]
This mod creates a very useful checklist of tasks for the day which dynamically updates depending on what tasks are left. You can also individually select the tasks for which overlays should be drawn to make it easier to find them. Now you can go to bed a night knowing you have definitely watered all your crops and milked all your cows.

Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.2+. Requires SMAPI 1.10 or later.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Run the game using SMAPI

[/list]
